newsitem.title: USA: SEC clears NASD rule on data release to public.
newsitem.headline: SEC clears NASD rule on data release to public.

text.p: SEC said it approved a National Association of Securities Dealers plan to provide copies of NASD disciplinary complaints and decisions involving its member dealers to the public.

The public can request the information, including pending disciplinary actions against dealers, by letter or telephone, using a toll-free number, according to NASD's plan approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission.

NASD may release information about a dealer's past and present employment history; final disciplinary actions taken by federal, state or foreign securities agencies; pending disciplinary actions; and criminal indictments and convictions, the approved NASD plan says.
NASD also will release information about civil judgments and arbitration decisions in securities and commodities disputes involving public customers.
